description.narrative: Core support to Centers for Civic Initiative (CCI)
Kärnstöd till Centers for Civic Initiative (CCI)

The overall objectives of the Core support are CCI's main strategic priorities defined by its Strategic plan 20222027, which revolve around the following impact areas: Good governance and citizen participation; Countering corruption and misuse of public resources; The rule of law and election processes: EU integration; Sustainable civil society. The submitted strategic plan accompanied with the well-elaborated budget are acceptable for Sida.

The results presented below correspond to five thematic areas defined by the strategy of CCI: A) Good governance and citizen participation CCI, together with its partners, made significant progress in various governance sectors, addressing systemic issues, advocating for vulnerable groups, and enhancing civic engagement. Those initiatives have improved public transparency and accountability and empowered communities and their access to rights previously overlooked or denied. B) Countering corruption and misuse of public resources CCI, together with other civic groups, achieved significant legal and policy victories against illegal activities in the construction of small hydro power plants, termination of concessions, withdrawal of licenses, and revocation of environmental permits on the Neretvica, Jablanica, Buna, and Ugar rivers. C) The rule of law and election processes CCI focused on enhancing the capacities of the judiciary and enforcement agencies to respond effectively to evidence based reports of election offenses. Voter pressure in BiH emerged as a critical issue, over 40% of citizens had experienced some form of political pressure. D) EU integrations The Resource Center for Civil Society Organizations has been successfully established as a central support point for the development of the civil sector in BiH, with a special focus on the European integration process. Through the Center's redesigned website, an efficient platform has been created for communication and information sharing among CSOs across the country. E) Sustainable civil society CCI has conducted educational trainings to strengthen the capacities of a wide range of civil society organizations in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The trainings focused on four areas: project monitoring and evaluation, financial management, fundraising, and public relations and media.
